commands.name: g7-proc-policy-cycle
commands.command:
bash -c $'
s() { echo "  procfs=[$(findmnt -no OPTIONS /proc)] fstab_mark=$(grep -c twebproxy-proc-hardening /etc/fstab) www-data_sees_pid1=$(setpriv --reuid=33 --regid=33 --clear-groups sh -c "test -r /proc/1/cmdline && echo yes || echo no")"; }
echo "status:"; twebproxy proc-hardening status >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "  rc=$?"; s
echo "disable:"; twebproxy proc-hardening disable >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "  rc=$?"; s; twebproxy proc-hardening status >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "  status rc=$? (0 = accepted risk recorded? / policy file removed with core)"
echo "enable:"; twebproxy proc-hardening enable >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "  rc=$?"; s
echo "boot path: reset /proc to defaults, then systemd-remount-fs.service applies /etc/fstab"
mount -o remount,hidepid=default /proc; s
systemctl restart systemd-remount-fs.service; echo "  remount-fs rc=$?"; s'

commands.name: g7-proc-boot-path
commands.command:
bash -c $'
s() { echo "  procfs=[$(findmnt -no OPTIONS /proc)] www-data_sees_pid1=$(setpriv --reuid=33 --regid=33 --clear-groups sh -c "test -r /proc/1/cmdline && echo yes || echo no")"; }
echo "reset /proc as a fresh boot mounts it (hidepid=0):"; mount -o remount,hidepid=0 /proc; s
echo "systemd-remount-fs.service (the boot unit that applies /etc/fstab options to /proc):"; systemctl restart systemd-remount-fs.service; echo "  rc=$?"; s'
